body.Title: PFMOffices
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) list of coordinating offices: one row per office, with its endorser and coordination role. Endorsement routing reuses it. Office data stays in SharePoint.

body.Title: PFMProcessSteps
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) list of process steps for one publication action, derived from Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, with Table A5.2 target business days. Status: draft, not verified.

body.Title: PFMSeries
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) list of publication series numbers and titles from Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, Attachment 2, Table A2.1. Add or rename a series here; no schema change is needed.

body.Title: PFMSettings
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) settings: one row per setting the app and flows read (wing name for the subtitle, PFM mailbox, defaults). Values are entered on the government computer, never in the code repository.

body.Title: PFMGuidance
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) guidance shown on each screen of the app: heading, audience, order, instructions and what must be done before moving on.

body.Title: PFMProductIndex
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) product index (PI) of all applicable organizational publications and forms that the PFM maintains (Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, 6.4.2).

body.Title: PFMPublications
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) record of actions: one row per action on a publication or form (Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, 1.1.4), with its process step, certification and approval. Each action points to its PFM Product Index row.

body.Title: PFMWaivers
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) record of waivers written into wing publications (Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, 9.5.3), with approval, renewal and notice dates.

body.Title: PFMActivityLog
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) record of events: status change, endorsement requested, reminder sent, status report e-mailed. One row per event. Flow run history expires after 28 days; this list keeps the record.

body.Title: PFMEndorsements
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) record of coordination: one row per coordinator per action, with stage, role, status, suspense, response and nonconcur resolution (Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, 3.4 and 5.1-5.5).

body.Title: PFMRecommendations
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) record of recommended changes to publications (Department of the Air Force (DAF) Form 847): inbound from a wing publication and outbound to a higher headquarters publication.

body.Title: PFMReviews
body.Description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) record of reviews: one row per periodic or special review of a product (Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, 7.4.2-7.4.4), with the office of primary responsibility (OPR) response, due dates and the follow-up action.

body.Title: Manpower and personnel
body.SuggestWhen:
Affects manpower and organization programs; allocates or controls manpower resources; or evaluates manpower use
Manages, provides, or otherwise affects medical services for military and civilians
Manages civilian or military personnel programs or manages social action programs (such as equal opportunity)
Manages or otherwise affects training and education programs, to include educational research, evaluation, curriculum development and review
Impacts or otherwise applies to morale, welfare, recreation, and services
Has manpower, personnel, and/or labor implications (requires negotiations and/or bargaining with the union)
Impacts Services programs designed to deliver capabilities to both space base deltas and deployed units
Impacts nonappropriated funded Services programs
Impacts postal service guidance
Impacts or otherwise applies to additional duties

body.Title: Intel
body.SuggestWhen:
Concerns plans, design, development, testing, acquisition maintenance, and disposal of weapon systems, automated information systems, software equipment, facilities, or services
Develops or analyzes strategic, defensive, and tactical operations, to include operational readiness, planning, standardization, system development, evaluation, training, or command and control
Impacts security programs, including safeguarding classified information, handling classified information, classification and declassification, personnel security, integrated defense, installation security, weapons system security, or security forces matters
Affects or impacts intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) policies or procedures
Impacts USSF ISR policies or procedures (item 29)
Concerns USSF special security or controlled access programs
Concerns training, education, and professional development of ISR Guardians
Impacts how USSF ISR resources are allocated

body.Title: Operations
body.SuggestWhen:
Involves or affects aircrew members, as defined in AFPD 11-4, Aviation Service
Develops or analyzes strategic, defensive, and tactical operations, to include operational readiness, planning, standardization, system development, evaluation, training, or command and control
Affects or involves international affairs related to training issues, including disclosure of information to foreign governments
Manages or otherwise affects aircrew flying training and/or aircrew education
Affects or impacts counter-chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear (CBRN), countering weapons of mass destruction, or CBRN survivability policies and procedures

body.Title: Logistics, Engineering and Force Protection
body.SuggestWhen:
Concerns plans, design, development, testing, acquisition, maintenance, logistics support, sustainment, and disposal of weapon systems, automated information systems, software equipment, facilities, or services
Concerns managing real estate, facilities, and civil engineering or public works programs; provides facility services
Concerns strategic munitions, including bombs, warheads, guided missiles and rockets, reentry vehicles and solid propellants
Manages safety programs, to include flight, weapons, systems safety; the Air Force Occupational and Environmental Safety, Fire Protection, and Health Standards (AFOSH); or Occupation Health and Safety Administration (OSHA) standards
Impacts security programs, including integrated defense, installation security, weapons system security, or security forces matters
Impacts or otherwise applies to morale, welfare, recreation, and services
Creates documentation requirements on organizations that use core automated maintenance system
Involves activities with potential environmental impacts, or involves the production, acquisition, or handling of hazardous materials
Impacts programs and policies regarding military munitions, remediation of property under the Military Munitions Response Program, demilitarization of military munitions, range clearances, explosive safety submissions, and first and emergency responder duties for responses to all-hazards including improvised explosive devices and weapons of mass destruction

body.Title: Air Force Futures
body.SuggestWhen:
Develops DAF strategy and multi-domain operating concepts integrating through centralized design, and validating (and prioritizing) operational capabilities-based requirements to achieve national defense objectives and deliver timely and effective capability to the warfighter
Bridges the gap between Strategy and Planning by providing a future force design relevant to the threat, strategy, and need to develop new ways of operating as a joint force

body.Title: Planning, Programming, Strategy and Operations
body.SuggestWhen:
Involves the DAF long-range resource allocation plan
Could impact program objective memorandum development or other programming activities
Could impact or affect DAF strategic planning or Service-level operational programming

body.Title: Strategic Deterrence and Nuclear Integration
body.SuggestWhen:
Strategy, policy, doctrine, vulnerabilities, force structure and analysis documents affecting strategic deterrence and assurance
Requirements, acquisition, programming, and budgeting processes for nuclear and global strike capabilities
Strategic munitions, including bombs, warheads, guided missiles and rockets, reentry vehicles, and solid propellants
Nuclear enterprise capabilities and personnel requirements including key nuclear billets, 13N officer career field management, and USAF personnel reliability program
Nuclear command and control and nuclear command and control communications policy and guidance affecting nuclear command and control communications systems, doctrine, procedures, personnel, equipment, and facilities
Nuclear enterprise assessment and reporting data (e.g., metrics, trend analysis and performance)
Counter-CBRN, countering weapons of mass destruction, or CBRN (survivability policies and procedures)
Existing and future arms control treaties
DoD foreign clearance program policies and procedures

body.Title: Chaplain
body.SuggestWhen: Manages or affects religious services, to include related morale and welfare programs

body.Title: History and Museums Programs
body.SuggestWhen: Impacts history, heritage, or museums programs, and official lineage, honors, and emblems of organizations

body.Title: Safety
body.SuggestWhen:
Involves safety programs, to include aviation, occupational, weapons, space, systems, and human factors safety; the Air Force Occupational and Environmental Safety, Fire Protection, and Health Standards (AFOSH); or Occupation Health and Safety Administration (OSHA) standards
Involves the risk management process in the cyberspace domain
Involves activities with potential environmental impacts, or involves the production, acquisition, or handling of hazardous materials

body.Title: Surgeon General
body.SuggestWhen: Manages, provides, or otherwise affects medical services or medical training for military and civilians

body.Title: Chief Scientist
body.SuggestWhen: Involves scientific research, or requires scientific input and/or evaluation

body.Title: Auditor
body.SuggestWhen: Establishes audit objectives, policies, plans, or standards

body.Title: Acquisition, contracting
body.SuggestWhen:
Concerns plans, requirements, design, development, testing, acquisition, engineering, maintenance, fielding, product support, and disposal of weapon systems, automated information systems, business systems, software equipment, facilities or services
Manage safety programs, to include flight, weapons, systems safety; AFOSH; or OSHA standards
Impacts cyber security design considerations
Involves activities with potential environmental impacts, or involves the production, acquisition, or handling of hazardous materials
Involves science, technology, basic research, applied research, or advanced technology development
Impacts people, organizations, processes, procedures, and systems that are used to plan, develop, test, acquire, dispose of, conduct, execute, and support nuclear operations and forces
Involves starting new acquisition programs, modifying existing systems, and managing systems throughout the life cycle
Impacts contracting guidance including any changes or references to FAR, Defense FAR, and AF FAR
Involves industry, industrial preparedness or industrial facilities
Involves acquisition workforce management
Creates documentation requirements on organizations that use core automated maintenance system
Per HAFMD 1-10 and HAFMD 1-17, publication changes impacting space acquisition, integration, and contracting require SAF/AQ coordination with SAF/SQ

body.Title: Comptroller
body.SuggestWhen:
Financial implications to include budget; cost estimating and analysis; inflation and escalation; economic analysis, business case analysis, and other comparative analyses; cost and planning factors; nonappropriated funds; systems acquisition and sustainment; or acquisition workforce management
Adherence to regulatory and statutory language specific to budgeting and expenditure of funds, and is in one of the following publications series: 10, 14, 16, 20, 21, 23, 24, 25, 31, 32, 33, 34, 36, 38, 41, 44, 52, 61, 63, 64, 90 or 99

body.Title: Public Affairs; International Affairs; Foreign Policy Advisor Program (item 20 lists all three)
body.SuggestWhen:
Affects or involves international affairs, including disclosure of information to foreign governments (item 20)
Affects relations with congress or creates a requirement for legislative analysis (item 23)
Involves or affects relations with the general public
Affects procedures or policies for the development or dissemination of information for external or internal audiences
Affects procedures or policies for the dissemination of official information to external or internal audiences
Involves or affects relations with the media and/or general public
Involves visual information matters such as combat camera support, base level support (e.g., photography, broadcast, and graphics presentations); or authorizes visual information hardware or acquiring and using visual information products
Relates to matters that involve multiple forms of information (to include visual information) or strategic communication capabilities applied in support of organizational or mission objectives
Involves the promulgation of unclassified pre-decisional information to large groups of people
Involves contracts related to any of the above areas or to programs that are likely to face elevated public scrutiny because of the costs, technology involved or their close association with matters of public concern or debate (item 25)

body.Title: Inspector General Activities
body.SuggestWhen: Affects policy, plans, oversight, and/or standards impacting the following IG activity areas: complaints resolution; senior official inquiries; DAF inspections, to include notification, scheduling, and access to units via Gatekeeper program; special investigations; the Office of Special Investigations (OSI); the Defense Cyber Crimes Center (DC3)

body.Title: Local OSI office
body.SuggestWhen: Involves OSI or affects criminal or counterintelligence activities

body.Title: Office of Competitive Activities
body.SuggestWhen: Addresses pacing and acute challenges

body.Title: Studies and Analysis; Operations Analysis; A9; S9
body.SuggestWhen:
Could impact or affect DAF strategic planning or support to strategic analysis
Analyzes strategic, defensive, and tactical operations
Includes or impacts resources, recapitalization, modernization, investments and divestment analyses, operational assessments, risk assessment frameworks, digital computer models and simulations, studies management or lessons learned
DAF, and DoD decision support analysis and assessment
Subjects pertaining to data management/governance, data analytics, data science, data exploitation, information management, and knowledge management
Has future force structure implications

body.Title: Space Acquisition, Integration, and Contracting
body.SuggestWhen:
Concerns Space Test Program Management (AFI 10-1202)
Concerns all policy and related publications listed for SAF/AQ that impact acquisition, integration, and contracting for DAF space systems and programs
Per HAFMD 1-10 and HAFMD 1-17, publication changes impacting space acquisition, integration, and contracting require SAF/AQ coordination with SAF/SQ

body.Title: Local small business office and local contracting office (as related to contracting actions for small business)
body.SuggestWhen: Affects or impacts DAF small business programs, small business goals, accomplishments, plans and/or progress for achieving the small business goals

body.Title: PublicationsSiteName
body.SettingNotes: The wing site name in the ACCESSIBILITY statement ("This publication is available for download on the XXX-XXX SharePoint."). Set once at install (PFM 2026-11-13).

body.Title: PublicationsListUrl
body.SettingNotes: Address of the master publications list; the hyperlink behind the site name in the ACCESSIBILITY statement. Set once at install (PFM 2026-11-13).

body.Title: PFMOfficeMailbox
body.SettingNotes: PFM office mailbox that sends the AO-appointment and org-box e-mails (List design 2026-11-12 s6). Value entered by the PFM.

body.Title: EscalationWeekdays
body.SettingNotes: Weekdays before the org-box notice escalates (PFM 2.5B; List design 2026-11-12 s6). Value entered by the PFM.

body.Title: RecordsFreeze
body.SettingNotes: Yes or No. While set, stops every closeout deletion of Working Files (PFM 4.6A; AFI 33-322 6.1.1.4.3; List design 2026-11-12 s7). Value entered by the PFM.
